Caline Caline CP-xx series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Caline CP-70 High Chief - Crushing Overdrive Published on April 6, 2020 Caline CP-xx series overdrive pedal Information Caline Caline cp-70 crushing overdrive is a classic tone machine, with this pedal you get a lot of distortion and overdrive With 3 function knobs: Vol, Tone and Drive. With these controls combined, it allows a great deal of versatility This distortion pedal produces a good range on heavy overdrive to aggressive distortion with the option to open up lots of middle to the sound This pedal allows a subtle tone variation from the more compressed classic to the more open modern extreme sound With durable and stable aluminum alloy black shell and mini size, space-saving and portable Moded after a very famous and expensive pedal and you do not have to stand in line and wait a year to get one.
